data.normalization: Audited HF global statistics; raw nonfinite restored to zero, finite zero retained, finite/nonzero presence, group ANY. Fixed 28 channels in moonstone.CHANNELS order.
data.loader_claim: HDF5_DERIVED_PILOT; full-crop pair is separately reported within selected sample coverage, never global exact reproduction

age.target: official ordered case-sensitive age prefixes; unknown excluded
age.role: first formal training-chain validation; no absolute age regression

geology.role: core baseline; Train has 46 supported classes, absent Train classes also absent Val/Test; no unseen-class claim

training.loss: cross entropy without label smoothing or class weighting
training.schedule: warmup_steps=min(2*batches_per_epoch,total_steps//10); then cosine to zero; total_steps uses planned 50 epochs unchanged on resume
training.architecture: 28->64 Conv7 stride4 padding3 BN ReLU; 64->128 Conv3 stride2 padding1 BN ReLU; 128->256 Conv3 stride2 padding1 BN ReLU; adaptive average pool1; linear task output
upstream_differences: retain final partial batch instead of upstream drop_last=True
streaming validation and HDF5-derived pixels rather than mmap loader
training.selection: strictly greater Val full-K Macro-F1; earliest epoch wins ties; stop after five non-improving epochs
training.sequence: Age seed42 first; verify training/resources; Geology seed42; then remaining fixed seeds43/44 without changing configuration based on Test

metrics.absent_class: all K outputs included; F1=0 when support+prediction=0, matching pinned upstream downstream_base.py
metrics.supported_macro: only classes with ground-truth support; secondary and separately named
metrics.prior: fit only Train labels; empirical frequencies, no smoothing; infinite NLL reported explicitly when a true class has zero prior
metrics.aggregation: per seed and mean/std over fixed seeds; no choice of favorable seed or macro definition

candidate_controls: CandidateIDHead is candidate_id_control. Full/subset identity is against its own full softmax. Same encoder/modality/examples/budget required for trained comparisons; semantic scorer requires separate locked design.
